description: Build, publish, and analyze forms and their responses through the Forms app.

auth.setup: Use the Forms actions if they are already available. Otherwise add https://forms.agent-native.com/mcp as a remote MCP connector in OAuth-capable hosts, then complete the host-owned OAuth sign-in. Codex and Claude Cowork use the browser-authorized device-code flow at https://forms.agent-native.com/mcp/connect or npx @agent-native/core@latest connect https://forms.agent-native.com. Never ask the user to paste a token into chat.
